regions.merged_text: April 10th 1948. God bless you Joseph O'Donnell. - you and yours. I hope you are all well. Thanks be to God my strength seems to be coming back in pretty good shape, though rather slowly. I hope that Fr. O'Donnell is improving by this time and that the good God may give him the needed patience. Shortly after his consecration Bishop Murphy of Saginaw met with a serious accident that put him on his back for about six months in same position. A year afterwards his condition was perfect. Thanks be to God! We'll include Fr. O'D. in our prayers.
